title: WorkerUsage
description: HAR-145: what the model worker spent answering ONE request, returned as `usage` on the response of /v1/draft, /v1/strategies, /v1/judge, /v1/revise and /v1/human-delta. Core stores it per call (run_model_usage) and sums it into OperationalMetrics (operational_metrics.v1.json): a METRIC (HAR-97 M1-M5), never an eval. Every number is an exact sum over the provider completions the request made; a count the provider did not report is null (cached and reasoning tokens, cost) and is never estimated or taken as 0. A request answered from recorded cassettes (replay mode) spent nothing: its usage_source is replay and every count is 0 or null, whatever the cassette recorded. Tokens of a model answer that was discarded and retried (an unusable first answer) are not returned: the attempt is counted in retries only, so tokens are a lower bound when retries > 0. Usage is reported on successful responses only: a failed request's cost is not returned.

model_calls.description: Provider completions whose answer the request used; a discarded and retried attempt is counted in retries, not here. 0 in replay.

cached_input_tokens.description: The part of input_tokens served from the provider's prompt cache; null, or absent (the draft route omits nulls), unless every model call reported it.

reasoning_tokens.description: The part of output_tokens spent on hidden reasoning; null, or absent (the draft route omits nulls), unless every model call reported it.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls the model asked for during the request.

retries.description: Extra provider attempts: a rate-limit backoff, a hung-call retry, an invalid-output retry, a fallback-model switch.

model_ms.description: Time spent inside the provider layer (pacing, backoff and the completions), summed over its calls; concurrent calls add up, so it can exceed the request's wall time.

cost_usd.description: Sum of the provider-reported cost; null, or absent (the draft route omits nulls), unless every model call reported one.

usage_source.description: live: a real provider answered and the figures are what it reported. replay: recorded cassettes answered (tests, demos); nothing was spent and no figure is reported.

models.description: The models that answered, in first-use order.
